The attached close-up on magenta is the HEAD AND SHOULDERS of a BASE BODY of this game: a young woman, bald, in a tan undershift. Redraw that close-up EXACTLY as it is, pixel for pixel: the same bald head at the same size and position, the same face, eyes, brows, ears, neck, shoulders and undershift, changing NOTHING, and add ONLY her hair: LONG WAVY hair parted at the middle, framing the face past the ears and falling in soft waves over both shoulders to the chest, worn naturally at head size. Colour of the added part ONLY: NEUTRAL very light GREY (near white) fills with one mid-grey shadow tone and a dark grey outline; software tints it later. Everything that is not the added part stays identical. The background is a perfectly flat, uniform, solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere that is not the drawing: no gradient, no texture, no scene, no frame, no text; never pink, never magenta, never purple on the drawing itself.
